sample_mapping_evidence: RNAchildoriginalGEOsevenPPP/fourhealthy donors, onePBMCcapture each. Exactchild/superseriesGSM aliases checked; skinbulk andlargerclinical/flow cohortsnotadditional RNA replication.

source_processing: Sequencing output files were demultiplexed and coverted to fastq files using Cell Ranger v3.0.2 (10X genomics).
Cell Ranger was used to align demultiplexed reads to the reference genome, perform filtering, barcode counting, UMI counting and estimate the number of cells.
Data analaysis was performed in R using Seurat v3.

Supplementary_files_format_and_content: For each sample there are three associated files: tab-seperated values file containing barcdoes, tab-separated file containing annotated genes (features), matrix file containing UMI counts and indices for the barcode and gene tsv files
source_metadata.source_barcode_scope: Original raw droplet whitelist; barcode rows are not called cells. Existing minimum RNA QC applied before AnnData construction. Original RNA counts and later QC thresholds unchanged; source preconversion audit retained in run.json.
